title: Employees (managing active staff)

sections.title: Employee profile – explanation of the tabs

html:
Menu: HR → Employees

The Employees module is the central register of the operation. Here we manage the master data, the employment relationship, the organisational classification and the statuses (active, on probation, on leave, terminated).

10.8.1Employee list and quick actions

In the Employees list, active employees and those on probation are shown by default. You can filter by department, manager, status and starting date. At the end of the row there are quick actions: Open, Transfer, Terminate.

10.8.2Employee profile – explanation of the tabs

  • Profile tab: personal and contact data.

  • Employment tab: contractual data.

  • Organisation tab: department, manager and site.

  • Documents tab: contracts and other files.

  • Audit tab: it lists every change.

10.8.3Editing the profile (simple modification)

Certain fields (phone, address, emergency contact) can simply be edited. For these there is no separate “change” form, because they do not affect the organisational and employment data.
